description: The project's MCP entries for Claude Code: poly's own tools, and the project's workflows served on poly-runtime, every work order through the gate (PT10, S174). Claude Code reads them from the project's .mcp.json.
notes: The plugin (the language server and the skill): claude plugin marketplace add ${POLY_ROOT}/adapters, then claude plugin install poly@poly.

Workflows run on poly-runtime, each work order through the gate (S164, S173): admit the project first, and give poly.json a run field naming its certificate, store, trust and approvals folder (S188, S189).
